|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 3) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is the current version. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-D-coruscant_ai.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); a later copy of the same image in another format is not (13 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' compared with the previous version (the high-resolution image of 13 July 2023; left = before, right = after): [[File:V3-D-coruscant_ai-2025-01-24-vs-hires-2023-07-13-changes.png|frameless|upright=2]].
* '''Original''' ([[Coruscant (V) (ALT)]]): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 13 July 2023<ref name="img-altpng-2e6b92f-coruscantaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/coruscant_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2e6b92fecff4d08d9a08ec90a6634eeec690dd6b commit 2e6b92f] (13 July 2023) (“Locations”). No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/coruscant_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>. The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; label “(AI)”; line “Official AI - 2022 6 of 9”; bottom margin “Coruscant (Dark) (Coruscant)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' While you control, gains one [Light Side] icon.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Coruscant (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 13 July 2023<ref name="img-altpng-a98bff7-coruscantaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/coruscant_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a98bff721d819e36b343e60587d658ef767b2fba commit a98bff7] (13 July 2023) (“Series 5 AIs”). No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/coruscant_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>. '''What changed:''' re-uploaded the same day (commit “Locations”) turned the right way as a landscape image; the first upload had the card on its side. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; label “(AI)”; line “Official AI - 2022 6 of 9”; bottom margin “Coruscant (Dark) (Coruscant)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' While you control, gains one [Light Side] icon.”
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): '''What changed''' (compared with the previous version, the high-resolution image of 13 July 2023): re-rendered: the line “Official AI - 2022 6 of 9” was removed and the Players Committee logo added. PC card image uploaded 24 January 2025<ref name="img-altpng-f8913a9-large">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/coruscant_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/f8913a9b3f8485a741cd7db63a6dcf7b066a6085 commit f8913a9] (24 January 2025); the PC serves the latest version of each file at res.starwarsccg.org/cards/. The commit date is the upload date.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Coruscant (Coruscant) (Dark)”. It is the current image. Text: “'''Light Side:''' While you control, gains one [Light Side] icon.”
